items.statement: Hipgnosis Songs Fund's first annual report said its first 12 catalogs (£120m) 'represented a blended acquisition multiple of 12.75x historical three year average net income'
items.context: Hipgnosis Songs Fund's first acquisitions, June 2018 to March 2019
items.source: Music Business Worldwide — Hipgnosis already owns over 5,000 songs – with another $1bn-plus of deals in its sights

items.statement: Hipgnosis Songs Fund report: since IPO, catalogs acquired or under exclusivity with a total value of £387m 'represents an aggregate multiple of 12.56x annual net income'
items.context: All Hipgnosis catalogs acquired or under exclusivity from IPO to mid-2019
items.source: Music Business Worldwide — Hipgnosis already owns over 5,000 songs – with another $1bn-plus of deals in its sights

items.statement: Hipgnosis Songs Fund said the $322.9m it paid for Kobalt Capital's first fund 'represents a 18.3X blended acquisition multiple on the catalog's historic annual income'
items.context: Hipgnosis purchase of 42 catalogs (33,000+ songs) from Kobalt Capital
items.source: Music Business Worldwide — Hipgnosis Songs Fund buys huge catalog from Kobalt in $322.9m acquisition

items.statement: Hipgnosis Songs Fund results: cumulative expenditure of about $2bn since its 2018 IPO 'represents an average/blended acquisition multiple of 15.32x'
items.context: All Hipgnosis Songs Fund acquisitions from 2018 to early 2021
items.source: Music Business Worldwide — Hipgnosis Songs Fund now owns a music catalog worth over $2.2 billion

items.statement: Hipgnosis Songs Fund's $2.21bn independent portfolio valuation 'reflected a multiple of 17.96x historical annual net publisher share income'
items.context: Fair-value multiple of the whole Hipgnosis portfolio. This is a valuation, not a purchase price.
items.source: Music Business Worldwide — Hipgnosis Songs Fund now owns a music catalog worth over $2.2 billion

items.statement: Round Hill Music Royalty Fund said its acquisitions 'were completed at a blended multiple of 16.2x historic annual net revenues'
items.context: 38 catalogs plus a 29.1% stake in RH Carlin Holdings, about $342m invested as of June 30, 2021
items.source: Music Business Worldwide — Round Hill's UK Fund has spent $342m on acquisitions – and is buying catalogs at a multiple of 16.2x

items.statement: Round Hill Music Royalty Fund said copyrights bought since July 2021 'were acquired at an average historic three-year net publisher's share multiple of 17.9x'
items.context: 5,600+ compositions bought with $86.5m of C-share proceeds plus credit facility
items.source: Music Business Worldwide — Round Hill's UK fund has acquired 5,600 songs since July, paying an average multiple of 17.9x

items.statement: Reservoir Media's investor factsheet says its average acquisition multiple has been 14.7x, and that it has on average reduced the 'effective multiple' by 2.3x afterwards
items.context: Reservoir's catalog acquisitions in recent years, measured on Net Publisher Share / Net Label Share
items.source: Music Business Worldwide — Reservoir Media has spent over $695m on catalogs to date (and 5 other things we learned about the company from its new Investor Factsheet)

items.statement: Reservoir Media's investor factsheet: a $101.3m acquisition in 2021 was bought at 18.3x Net Label Share ($5.5m); NLS rose to $8.7m in FY2022, cutting the effective multiple to 11.7x
items.context: A single 2021 recorded-music acquisition by Reservoir, whose name the factsheet does not give
items.source: Music Business Worldwide — Reservoir Media has spent over $695m on catalogs to date (and 5 other things we learned about the company from its new Investor Factsheet)

items.statement: Citrin Cooperman's independent valuation of Round Hill Music Royalty Fund used 'a multiple of 19.56X annual net revenue', which it said matched the average multiple paid for publishing catalogs in comparable H2 2022–H1 2023 deals
items.context: Valuation of Round Hill fund assets (incl. Carlin stake) at about $654.75m. Concord's accepted offer of $468.8m was lower.
items.source: Music Business Worldwide — Concord is ready to pay $468.8m to buy Round Hill's UK fund. How did it reach that price?

items.statement: Duetti's Music Finance Index H2 2026 (a survey of its industry panel) lists perceived multiples for catalogs older than 10 years of 10.2x for masters and 12.1x for publishing, based on annual revenue
items.context: Sell-side expectations for independent catalogs. Younger catalogs get lower multiples, e.g. 3.8x–5.1x for masters aged 6–24 months.
